Hear from the clinicians who rely on Doximity every day.

I transferred a patient to another hospital several years ago and was able to quickly fax and send patient info via the Doximity app to my former medical school classmate who was working at the other hospital. It was 3am and the patient was admitted directly to the ICU. It was fantastically smooth and saved us so much time rather than having to traditionally fax medical records and information. Every little bit of time helps.

I use this application on a daily basis. I use the Doximity dialer to call patients from my personal phone so that my personal number doesn't show up on their caller ID. Nothing but praise. Thanks, Doximity!

I frequently consult my colleagues in different specialties using the Doximity app. I frequently utilize Doximity to access articles for teaching rounds as well as sharing articles with my colleagues. It allows me to multi-task and take care of patients while not being confined to a desk.
The fact that Doximity Ask provides links to full-text medical journals, tables and society practice guidelines differentiates it from the crowd.
Partnering with healthcare's most respected institutions.
Leading health systems across the country rely on Doximity to connect with clinicians.

What makes Doximity the network clinicians trust
Doximity gives clinicians the tools to work smarter, communicate faster, and focus on what matters most: their patients.
We’re No. 1 for clinicians

Our professional medical network has a larger membership than the American Medical Association, and more doctors use Doximity than Epic, the top EMR in the United States. Doximity’s membership has expanded to include over 85% of physicians and an increasing number of NPs, PAs, and pharmacists. Aside from the iPhone, there’s never been a piece of technology adopted by clinicians as quickly as Doximity. If you’re a clinician, claim your profile today.
We take care of those who take care of others

Doximity’s passion for addressing the workflow needs and practice pain points of clinicians is core to our product development. We believe that when the whole care coordination team is connected, patients benefit and the medical sector can work more efficiently and have a bigger impact. Our “clinician-first” mentality allows us to listen to the needs of clinicians and inspires us to build simple, easy-to-use tools to solve complex problems.
Medicine is mobile, and so are we

Clinicians are mobile by nature, so Doximity’s suite of tools have been developed keeping this in mind. You can send and receive electronic faxes conveniently while you’re on-the-go, securely collaborate on patient treatment when you’re on-call, and call patients from your cell phone while displaying your office number. With Doximity, you can be more productive and efficient without sacrificing convenience. Download our mobile apps.
Our expertise in digital health runs deep

The Doximity team includes health tech leaders from institutions and employers such as Cleveland Clinic, Stanford University, UCSF and Medscape. Our CEO Jeff Tangney previously founded Epocrates (EPOC) and our co-founder Dr. Nate Gross previously founded Rock Health, the first venture fund for digital health. Our expertise is further bolstered by industry thought leaders on our advisory board and our healthcare-focused investors, including Emergence Capital Partners, InterWest Partners, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley.
Meet the people building for clinicians
We're a passionate team of people driven by one goal: making clinicians' lives easier.
Want to make a difference in healthcare?
We’re hiring across engineering, design, clinical, and business teams. Remote-friendly and mission-driven.
Have a question? We'd love to hear from you.
Whether you need support, want to explore a partnership, or have a press inquiry, the right person is just a message away.
Have a technical issue or need help with your account? Our support team is ready to assist.
Interested in working with Doximity? Let's talk about how we can build something together.
Working on a story about Doximity? Reach out to our communications team.
500 3rd St. Suite 510 · San Francisco, CA 94107

raw_blocks: The clinicians you need are already here.

Over 85% of U.S. physicians are already on Doximity. Talent Solutions turns that network into your recruiting advantage, with tools to hire directly, experts for hard searches, and locums to cover gaps now.
Talk to our team See how it works

Doximity Talent Solutions is the recruitment division of Doximity — the leading clinical AI platform and largest professional medical network in the U.S. We help hiring teams find and hire clinicians across locums, permanent search, and direct sourcing.
Built for every stage of clinician hiring.
Whether you need coverage now, a hard search solved, or a smarter way to recruit at scale, Doximity has a solution built for that moment.
A gap opened up. Service lines are expanding. Patient access is at risk. You need a qualified clinician in place fast, without sacrificing quality or burning out your team.
I need to fill a role
A critical position has been open too long. Your team is stretched. You need a dedicated search partner with the reach and expertise to find the right fit, not just the available one.
I want to recruit smarter
For recruitment teams who want to level up their search, get direct access to 3M+ clinicians and AI-powered outreach on the platform that reaches physicians where they already are.
Our Approach to Workforce Strategy
Find out what your open role is actually costing you.
HOW ONE OPEN ROLE COMPOUNDS COST
A Cardiology physician vacancy costs over $766,667 after 4 months. Nearly $6,389 every day it stays open.
Physicians don't just join Doximity. They actively use it.
With over 10M daily platform interactions, clinicians come to Doximity every day to use clinical AI tools, run telehealth visits, read medical news, and manage their careers.
68% of physicians report being open to a career change, yet most aren't actively searching job boards. They're on a platform woven into how they practice medicine day-to-day.
That's where our recruiting advantage starts.
What our partners are saying...

We had to launch a new FQHC project and needed a full clinical team across 9 specialties within a strict 3-month window . Doximity moved fast and made it happen. These physicians are now providing quality care, from primary health to complex neurosurgery, for a community that relies on these services.
Assistant Director for Recruitment, Community Health System

We spent 5 years covering our Hem/Onc vacancy with locums and worked with multiple firms without a permanent solution. Doximity stepped in and within 52 days identified a qualified candidate with ties to our community who accepted the role. Our oncology patients have the long-term provider they've been waiting for.
Provider Recruitment Program Manager, Nonprofit Integrated Health Network

My click-through rate runs consistently in the high 40s to mid 50s. I sent a single DocMail to a psychiatrist for a remote Medical Director role. She accepted, then referred me to an APP for a new clinic we were opening, who then referred me to a therapist for that same clinic. One outreach turned into three hires.
Recruitment Manager, Behavioral Health Provider
The physicians you need are already here. Let's find them.
Whether you're solving a coverage gap today or building a long-term recruitment strategy, Doximity Talent Solutions has the network, tools, and team to help.
